ch0119_90_gladion/0101_0701_01_10:
There you are, [Name:PlayerNickname ].
You look raring to go today.
ch0119_90_gladion/0101_0701_02_10:
If you’re looking for someone to battle,
I volunteer.
ch0119_90_gladion/7101_0701_01_10:
I realized recently that all my days spent
fighting my own solitude weren’t in vain.
ch0119_90_gladion/7101_0701_02_10:
I have my partner and friends to thank
for that.
ch0119_90_gladion/7101_0701_03_10:
All the things I’ve experienced are what’ll
lead me and my partner to even greater
heights.
ch0119_90_gladion/7102_0701_01_10:
The other day, Lillie’s hem was torn, so I
fixed it for her.
ch0119_90_gladion/7102_0701_02_10:
She said it ripped while she was helping a
kid who tripped.
ch0119_90_gladion/7102_0701_03_10:
It seems she’s gone from someone others
protect to someone who protects others.
ch0119_90_gladion/7103_0701_01_10:
Pokémon built by humans are still Pokémon.
They’re doing their best to live, just like us.
ch0119_90_gladion/7103_0701_02_10: That’s why I want to protect ALL Pokémon.
ch0119_90_gladion/7104_0701_01_10:
From past experience, I’ve learned there are
different types of strength.
ch0119_90_gladion/7104_0701_02_10: Hau’s optimism is one reason he’s so strong.
ch0119_90_gladion/7104_0701_03_10: You also have your own kind of strength.
ch0119_90_gladion/7104_0701_04_10:
I’ll be around, watching and learning what
makes you so strong.
ch0119_90_gladion/7105_0701_01_10:
Being next to you just feels right somehow,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0119_90_gladion/7105_0701_02_10:
I bet your Pokémon must also be happy to
battle by your side.
ch0119_90_gladion/7105_0701_03_10:
As for me...I don’t hate battling beside you
either.
ch0119_90_gladion/1701_0701_01_10: Perfect timing. Here, you can have this.
ch0119_90_gladion/1701_0702_01_10: Heh. How you use it is up to you.
ch0119_90_gladion/2501_0701_01_10:
I heard from Cynthia and the others that
Silvally was created based on myths about
Arceus.
ch0119_90_gladion/2501_0701_02_10:
In other words, Arceus is the original
Silvally.
ch0119_90_gladion/2501_0701_03_10:
Having the power of the original creator...
It’s kind of a strange connection, isn’t it?
ch0119_90_gladion/2501_0702_01_10:
Silvally and I can’t change the past, but the
future is ours to choose.
ch0119_90_gladion/2501_0702_02_10:
We intend to use the bonds we’ve built to
head toward the future at full power.
ch0119_90_gladion/2511_0701_01_10:
Silvally seems to enjoy spending time with
Magearna and Porygon.
ch0119_90_gladion/2511_0701_02_10:
They’re all Pokémon that were built by
humans, so maybe they can bond over that.
ch0119_90_gladion/2511_0702_01_10:
Your partner Pokémon always seems to be
enjoying itself.
ch0119_90_gladion/2511_0702_02_10:
It’s not easy to build a strong bond with a
Pokémon...
ch0119_90_gladion/2511_0702_03_10: so treasure the bonds you’ve got, OK?
ch0119_90_gladion/3001_0701_01_10:
The sun is so bright... This sunlight is
different from what we get in Alola.
ch0119_90_gladion/3003_0701_01_10:
I don’t hate when it’s calm and quiet.
There was a time it was wasted on me,
though.
ch0119_90_gladion/3005_0701_01_10:
Perhaps it’s only in the dark that our true
power can be tested.
